why: merge_authority.check_project read the project's AGENTS.md with read_text(encoding='utf-8') and caught only OSError, so a brief that is not UTF-8 raised UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError) out of mhw check: a Python traceback on stderr and exit 1, with no PROJECT line.
